policy.normalRemoteMode: Remote Chat and Remote Sales are primary; Local RPC and UIA remain fallback paths.
policy.remoteOnlyAuditMode: Local RPC is not started and UIA cannot supply production evidence.

dependencies.fallbackValue: Restores local main chat when the Backend or Remote authorization path is unavailable.
dependencies.removalRisk: High until Remote-only soak and recovery evidence is complete.

dependencies.component: Discord Local RPC Sales message source
dependencies.fallbackValue: Supplies Sales messages when ForceLegacy is selected or Remote Sales cannot establish a canonical source.
dependencies.removalRisk: High while the supported rollback policy includes Legacy Sales.

dependencies.component: Local Discord RPC OAuth and protected client secret
dependencies.remoteReplacement: Remote pairing claim -> DPAPI-protected Remote access credential
dependencies.fallbackValue: Authenticates the supported Local RPC fallback without a Bot credential in WPF.
dependencies.removalRisk: High if Local RPC is retained; otherwise removable only with the entire Legacy path.

dependencies.component: Discord UI Automation Sales completion evidence
dependencies.remoteReplacement: Backend canonical completion observations in Sales bootstrap/mutation events
dependencies.fallbackValue: Supplies completion evidence only when policy explicitly enters UIA fallback; it may run as a non-production shadow in normal mode.
dependencies.removalRisk: Medium to high until Remote-only soak, authorization, and reconnect evidence is accepted.

dependencies.component: Discord accessibility launch and remediation UI
dependencies.remoteReplacement: Not used by normal Remote production paths
dependencies.fallbackValue: Makes the retained UIA fallback recoverable by the user.

dependencies.component: Legacy forwarded-message, sticker, and rich-message normalization fallbacks
dependencies.remoteReplacement: Structured Protocol v1 Chat contracts and Backend Discord normalizer
dependencies.fallbackValue: Preserves presentation when older/local payloads omit structured fields.
dependencies.removalRisk: Low to medium; removal can regress uncommon Discord payload variants.

dependencies.component: Local RPC guild/channel resolution, subscription, and bootstrap
dependencies.callPath: DiscordConnectionCoordinator -> channel resolver -> MESSAGE_CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE subscriptions -> snapshots
dependencies.remoteReplacement: Authorized Remote channel catalog plus independent Chat bootstrap/stream
dependencies.fallbackValue: Required by the Local RPC rollback path.
dependencies.removalRisk: High if removed before Local RPC retirement.

dependencies.component: Legacy onboarding, reconnect, and health/remediation surfaces
dependencies.remoteReplacement: Remote settings, pairing, channel selection, and health snapshot surfaces
dependencies.fallbackValue: Keeps the supported Legacy rollback understandable and operable.
dependencies.removalRisk: Medium; UI must be migrated with any later Legacy retirement.

dependencies.component: Gacha Overlay rc.1 manifest, packaging, manual, and public naming
dependencies.callPath: Release tooling and documentation; not a runtime data path
dependencies.fallbackValue: Preserves the published rc.1 contract during M9.x development.
dependencies.removalRisk: High if changed before the dedicated 2.0 release stage.
